approvalSource: Explicit EKODI Platform Super Administrator instruction in the ChatGPT conversation to build and continue the shared per-workspace channel connection and publishing automation architecture, with Church devotional as a reusable devotional_daily template on the common automation core.
summary: Register the guarded service-to-service publishing bridge inside the existing Marketing Publishing independent-service boundary so internal automation services can use workspace-owned channel connections without receiving provider OAuth credentials.
authorityRule: Internal automation services may request publication only for explicitly allowlisted workspace subjects, through per-service credentials, active workspace automation delegation, and existing workspace-owned channel connections. They receive no OAuth management authority and no provider refresh tokens.
channelBindingRule: A YouTube publication must fail closed unless the selected channel record, encrypted OAuth Vault connection and live Google OAuth channel context resolve to the same external channel identity.
dataRule: Provider credentials remain encrypted in the existing Channel Automation credential vault. The additive provider-schedule ledger stores publication metadata and external post references only, never access, refresh or bearer tokens.
migrationPolicy: Additive. Reuse the existing Marketing Publishing service, OAuth Vault, immutable workspace_id authority and guarded release owner. Add only a service bridge and provider-schedule ledger; do not create a tenant-owned publisher or duplicate OAuth store.
rollbackPlan: Disable the internal service allowlist and per-service credential, revert the bridge and additive schedule-ledger migration through the guarded pipeline, and leave all existing workspace channel connections, OAuth Vault records and browser publishing flows intact.
